lines.zh: 在石岸上摇摇摆摆地走，感觉就像在溜冰鞋上滑行一样。
lines.en: Waddle along the shore, as if skating on ice.

lines.zh: 在冰面上滑行得更快了，就像在冰上滑旱冰一样。
lines.en: Sliding faster on ice, like I’m skating without skates.

lines.zh: 在水中轻松地游泳，享受着冷水带来的舒适。
lines.en: Swimming easily in water, enjoying the coolness.

lines.zh: 如果有人靠近，我会游得更快，以防万一。
lines.en: If someone gets close, I’ll swim faster as a precaution.

lines.zh: 看到螃蟹的时候，总忍不住好奇地打量它们一番。
lines.en: Can’t help but take a good look at the crabs.

lines.zh: 在水里划船的时候，会获得速度加成，真是太棒了！
lines.en: When rowing in the water, I get speed boosts – awesome!

lines.zh: 在陆地上摇摇摆摆地走，仿佛我就是这里的小丑。
lines.en: Waddle around on land, like I’m the little clown here.

lines.zh: 看到游客投喂的食物，总是忍不住好奇上前查看。
lines.en: Can’t resist checking out the food tourists throw.

lines.zh: 在水里游泳时，享受着冷水带来的凉爽。
lines.en: Swimming in the water, enjoying the coolness.

lines.zh: 在陆地上时，总是保持优雅的步伐。
lines.en: Always keeping my elegant pace on land.

lines.zh: 肚皮贴着湿石头，我一摇一晃往前走。
lines.en: Belly close to the wet stone, I waddle on.

lines.zh: 浪打上来，我退两步再接着走。
lines.en: A wave hits; I back up two steps and carry on.

lines.zh: 鳍肢向后一摆，我把重心稳住。
lines.en: I swing my flippers back and steady myself.

lines.zh: 沿着岸线走，每块石头都踩一遍。
lines.en: I trace the shoreline, stepping on every stone.

lines.zh: 小碎步下坡，脚掌抓紧石缝。
lines.en: Short steps downhill, toes gripping the cracks.

lines.zh: 踩过滑石，我把身子往浪里侧倾。
lines.en: Crossing slick rock, I lean toward the surf.

lines.zh: 站在岸边，眺望着水面，寻找觅食的机会。
lines.en: Standing on the shore, scanning the water for food.

lines.zh: 悠闲地漫步在冰面上，感受着寒风的吹拂。
lines.en: Strolling on the ice, feeling the chill breeze.

lines.zh: 在水中悠闲地游泳，享受这份宁静。
lines.en: Swimming leisurely in the water, enjoying the peace.

lines.zh: 在陆地上悠闲地踱步，似乎对一切都能泰然处之。
lines.en: Strolling leisurely on land, seemingly at peace with everything.

lines.zh: 看着游客们投喂的食物，垂涎欲滴，但不敢上前。
lines.en: Looking at the food tourists are throwing, drooling but not daring to go for it.

lines.zh: 在水中悠然自得地游泳，享受这份自由。
lines.en: Swimming freely in the water, enjoying this freedom.

lines.zh: 在岸边悠闲地站定，仿佛在思考什么问题。
lines.en: Standing still on the shore, as if thinking about something.

lines.zh: 在陆地上悠闲地踱步，仿佛在享受一场舞蹈。
lines.en: Strolling on land, as if dancing gracefully.

lines.zh: 在岸边悠闲地踱步，仿佛在欣赏周围的美景。
lines.en: Strolling on the shore, as if admiring the scenery.

lines.zh: 在水中悠然自得地游泳，仿佛在进行一场优雅的比赛。
lines.en: Swimming freely in the water, as if competing in a graceful race.

lines.zh: 我缩起脚，把肚皮搁在石头上。
lines.en: I tuck my feet and rest my belly on the stone.

lines.zh: 理了理胸前的羽毛，风有点冷。
lines.en: I smooth the feathers on my chest; the wind is cold.

lines.zh: 盯着水面，等鱼影靠近。
lines.en: Eyes on the water, waiting for a fish to pass.

lines.zh: 船划过去，我转头看桨留下的圈。
lines.en: A boat goes by; I turn to watch its ripples.

lines.zh: 我正在岸上慢慢摇摆行走，观察着水中的游动.
lines.en: I'm waddling along the shore, observing the swimming in the water.

lines.zh: 突然有一艘小船靠近，我感到一阵风速加成。
lines.en: A small boat approaches, giving me a speed boost.

lines.zh: 我跳入水中开始游泳，享受着清凉的水感。
lines.en: I jump into the water and swim, enjoying the cool sensation.

lines.zh: 陆地上好像有人在呼喊，可能是我的同类。
lines.en: It seems like there's someone calling out on the land, maybe one of my kind.

lines.zh: 一只企鹅在我身边徘徊，似乎也是被吸引而来。
lines.en: A penguin is wandering nearby, attracted by the same thing.

lines.zh: 我用蟹腿喂食了一只小企鹅，它欢快地叫着。
lines.en: I feed a small penguin with crab legs, and it chirps happily.

lines.zh: 这艘船离我太远，但我仍能看到它的轮廓。
lines.en: The boat is far away, but I can see its outline.

lines.zh: 远处似乎有什么危险，我必须警惕。
lines.en: There seems to be danger in the distance, I must be wary.

lines.zh: 我好奇地向那艘船靠近，想看看船上有什么。
lines.en: I curiously approach the boat, wanting to see what's on it.

lines.zh: 这艘船很熟悉，也许是我的同类留下的。
lines.en: This boat is familiar, maybe left by my own kind.

lines.zh: 石岸的石头把我划得遍体鳞伤。
lines.en: The rocks of the stony shore cut me all over.

lines.zh: 痛如刀割
lines.en: Painful wound.

lines.zh: 石岸上我走得摇，水里可稳。
lines.en: Wobbly on the stone shore. Steady in water.

lines.zh: 挣扎求生
lines.en: Struggling on.

lines.zh: 命悬一线
lines.en: On thin ice.

lines.zh: 伤口作痛
lines.en: Wound aches.

lines.zh: 血如泉涌
lines.en: Blood flows.

lines.zh: 命丧黄泉
lines.en: Perish here.

lines.zh: 劫后余生
lines.en: Miraculously alive.

lines.zh: 我肚皮贴着冰，疼得直抽。
lines.en: Belly to the ice, I twitch in pain.

lines.zh: 见到你很高兴！
lines.en: Nice to meet you!

lines.zh: 摇过来看看，我不咬人。
lines.en: Waddling over — I don't bite.

lines.zh: 跟我一起游泳吧。
lines.en: Swim with me.

lines.zh: 看我的游泳姿势。
lines.en: Watch my swimming style.

lines.zh: 你会得到速度加成！
lines.en: You'll get a speed boost!

lines.zh: 你离得太远了。
lines.en: You're too far away.

lines.zh: 靠近我，你会更快。
lines.en: Come closer, you'll move faster.

lines.zh: 小心，水中有危险。
lines.en: Watch out, there's danger in the water.

lines.zh: 一起玩水吧！
lines.en: Let's play in the water!

lines.zh: 坐船靠近我，会快一些。
lines.en: Sail close to me and you go faster.

lines.zh: 我碰到了你！你闻起来像蟹肉！
lines.en: I bumped into you! You smell like crab meat!

lines.zh: 快躲开！我的冰晶翅膀好锋利！
lines.en: Move away! My icy wings are sharp!

lines.zh: 这冰太滑了，小心别摔倒哦！
lines.en: This ice is slippery, watch out for falls!

lines.zh: 你触碰到了我的冰域，现在该你尝尝我的冰弹了！
lines.en: You touched my icy domain, now you'll taste my ice balls!

lines.zh: 别靠近我太近，我的冰剑可不好惹！
lines.en: Stay away, my ice swords aren't easily handled!

lines.zh: 我的冰鳞片能冻结你的动作！
lines.en: My icy scales can freeze your movement!

lines.zh: 小心，我的冰锥可以贯穿一切！
lines.en: Be careful, my ice spikes can pierce anything!

lines.zh: 你触碰到了我的冰壁，我得把你冻结起来！
lines.en: You touched my icy wall, I'll freeze you now!

lines.zh: 用蟹腿来驯服我吧，这是你们唯一的选择！
lines.en: Tame me with a crab leg, that's your only choice!

lines.zh: 你离得太近了，我会用冰枪射击你！
lines.en: You're too close, I'll shoot you with an ice gun!

lines.zh: 找个伴侣，快点！我们要繁殖了！
lines.en: Find a mate, hurry! We need to breed!

lines.zh: 来吧，我等不及要和你在一起了！
lines.en: Come on, I can't wait to be with you!

lines.zh: 你愿意和我一起游泳吗？
lines.en: Do you want to swim with me?

lines.zh: 让我看看你的蟹腿，我可以用它们来繁殖！
lines.en: Let me see your crab legs, I can use them to breed!

lines.zh: 你看起来很好吃，但我们要繁殖！
lines.en: You look delicious, but we need to breed!

lines.zh: 来吧，让我们一起滑翔吧！
lines.en: Come on, let's glide together!

lines.zh: 我会游泳，你也试试看吧！
lines.en: I can swim, try it yourself!

lines.zh: 别再想捕食我了，我要繁殖了！
lines.en: Stop thinking about eating me, I'm breeding now!

lines.zh: 让我们在水中畅游吧！
lines.en: Let's swim in the water!

lines.zh: 你准备好和我一起繁殖了吗？
lines.en: Are you ready to breed with me?

lines.zh: 我摇摇摆摆走过去嗅了嗅。
lines.en: I waddle over and sniff it.

lines.zh: 脚掌触地
lines.en: Taps my feet on the cold, hard ground.

lines.zh: 我用鳍状臂拨了拨那东西。
lines.en: I nudged the thing with my flipper.

lines.zh: 潜入水中
lines.en: Dive into the icy water for a swim.

lines.zh: 划船靠近
lines.en: Approach me in the boat for a speed boost!

lines.zh: 享受鱼肉
lines.en: Yum, fish is always a treat!

lines.zh: 避开螃蟹
lines.en: Stay away from those creepy crabs.

lines.zh: 保护领地
lines.en: Watch my territory, it’s the best here.

lines.zh: 我在石缝里翻找小鱼。
lines.en: I rummage through the rock crevices for small fish.

lines.zh: 与人友好
lines.en: I like people who respect the water.

lines.zh: 察觉危险
lines.en: Sense danger and dive deeper.

lines.zh: 鱼群在浅水里翻了个白肚。
lines.en: A school of fish flashes silver in the shallows.

lines.zh: 水里有银光闪了一下，我盯住。
lines.en: A silver flash in the water; I fix on it.

lines.zh: 警告入侵者
lines.en: Waddle closer to warn the intruder.

lines.zh: 躲避攻击
lines.en: Quick, dive away from that net!

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，扫了一圈冰面。
lines.en: I stretch my neck and scan the ice.

lines.zh: 接近捕食者
lines.en: Stay alert for potential threats.

lines.zh: 石岸上摇着走，别催。
lines.en: Waddling on the stone shore. Do not rush me.

lines.zh: 观察猎物
lines.en: Observe the diver, they seem curious.

lines.zh: 警告入侵者远离
lines.en: Warn the diver to keep their distance.

lines.zh: 遇到企鹅时，请慢慢靠近。
lines.en: Approach the penguin slowly.

lines.zh: 企鹅摇摇摆摆地移动。
lines.en: The penguin moves clumsily.

lines.zh: 在水中，企鹅快速游泳。
lines.en: In water, the penguin swims fast.

lines.zh: 划船靠近企鹅可获得速度加成。
lines.en: Gain speed by approaching the penguin in a boat.

lines.zh: 企鹅可以通过蟹腿或鱼繁殖。
lines.en: Penguins breed with fish or crab legs.

lines.zh: 在陆地上，企鹅摇摇晃晃。
lines.en: On land, the penguin waddles.

lines.zh: 企鹅喜欢寒冷的石岸环境。
lines.en: Penguins prefer cold rocky shores.

lines.zh: 企鹅游泳时快速划水。
lines.en: The penguin strokes quickly when swimming.

lines.zh: 企鹅偶尔会潜水。
lines.en: The penguin occasionally dives.

lines.zh: 观察企鹅，别惊扰它。
lines.en: Observe the penguin without disturbing it.

lines.zh: 翅膀一拍，也是力气。
lines.en: A flipper slap is still a blow.

lines.zh: 小心！
lines.en: Be careful!

lines.zh: 我扑腾翅膀，啄你脚背！
lines.en: I flap my flippers and peck your foot!

lines.zh: 寒冷来袭！
lines.en: Freezing up!

lines.zh: 我侧身一滑，躲开你的手！
lines.en: I slide sideways, dodging your hand!

lines.zh: 冰面破裂！
lines.en: Ice breaks!

lines.zh: 抓紧！
lines.en: Hold on!

lines.zh: 水中追逐！
lines.en: Chase in water!

lines.zh: 速度提升！
lines.en: Speed up!

lines.zh: 冰上起舞！
lines.en: Dance on ice!

lines.zh: 企鹅在石岸上摇摇晃晃地走过，周围是绿色的丛林。
lines.en: Penguin waddles along on the rocky shore, surrounded by lush jungles.

lines.zh: 企鹅潜入水中，轻盈地划动着双腿。
lines.en: Penguin dived into the water, gracefully kicking with its legs.

lines.zh: 企鹅抬头望向你，用它那好奇的眼神注视着你。
lines.en: Penguin looks up at you, its curious eyes staring intently.

lines.zh: 企鹅在水中快速游动，偶尔露出头来换气。
lines.en: Penguin swims quickly in the water, occasionally surfacing to take a breath.

lines.zh: 企鹅在原木上悠闲地走动，似乎在寻找食物。
lines.en: Penguin saunters along the log, seemingly searching for food.

lines.zh: 企鹅在岸边的草地上跳来跳去，享受着温暖的阳光。
lines.en: Penguin bounces around on the grassy shore, basking in the warm sunlight.

lines.zh: 企鹅遇到一只螃蟹，好奇地靠近。
lines.en: Penguin approaches a crab with curiosity.

lines.zh: 企鹅在水中划船靠近，似乎想获得速度加成。
lines.en: Penguin paddles towards you in the water, seeking a speed bonus.

lines.zh: 企鹅在水中游泳，尾巴在水中轻轻摆动。
lines.en: Penguin swims in the water, its tail gently swaying.

lines.zh: 企鹅在陆地上慢走，偶尔停下来观察周围环境。
lines.en: Penguin walks slowly on land, pausing occasionally to observe the surroundings.

lines.zh: 被火焰烧伤了...
lines.en: Burnt by fire...

lines.zh: 摔了一跤...
lines.en: Fell down...

lines.zh: 石岸上，我摇摇摆摆走。
lines.en: On the stony shore I waddle.

lines.zh: 爆炸的冲击波...
lines.en: Shockwave from an explosion...

lines.zh: 箭射过来...
lines.en: Arrow hit me...

lines.zh: 紫色光晕缠住我，我站不稳...
lines.en: Purple light coils around me; I can't stand steady...

lines.zh: 饿得前胸贴后背...
lines.en: Hungry, starving...

lines.zh: 雷落在冰面上，我浑身一颤...
lines.en: Lightning struck the ice; my whole body jolts...

lines.zh: 又回到虚空中...
lines.en: Back to the void...
